title: Adani Ports' Colombo West terminal doubles capacity to 3.2 million TEUs with $750 million investment
desc: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone has successfully completed the expansion of the Colombo West International Terminal. This expansion doubled the terminal's capacity to 3.2 million TEUs following a USD 750 million investment. Sri Lankan Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya inaugurated the expanded facility, emphasizing its significance for the country's economy. The terminal's automated systems and deep-water capability enhance its competitive edge in global shipping.
